Treatment Rationale: Reduce the likelihood of unauthorized access to customer records through secure S3 configuration and monitoring.

Residual Risk Assessment: Provisional residual score remains 20 / Critical because C-001 and C-002 implementation has not been verified and supporting evidence E-001 through E-005 has not been collected. Reassess after control implementation and effectiveness testing.
Verification Evidence: S3 Block Public Access settings; bucket policy review; encryption configuration; monitoring configuration and test results
